title: Interconnect mesh law (post-v5)

claims.text: v5 organs (multi-res, HNSW, ranker, prefetch, contract, agents, causal) must couple through connect pass and organism; isolated tables are not interconnect.
Interconnect mesh status is operational telemetry only; it never grants host mutation rights or clears immune block.
Prefetch precision feeds causal episodes and ranker features; causal regressed recommends freeze/rollback candidates, never auto-edit.
Contracts constrain continuation, seal, and promote; they never expand authority or mint host.mutate.
All mesh edges write the same SQLite body (ledger, settings, memories); refuse a second interconnect database.

claim_boundary: Mesh packet teaches coupling law; never host authority.
